preparation: Pinned CSV downloads; normalized exact deduplication; conflicts removed from all splits; published test reserved; matching training texts removed; 15% of remaining training pool stratified into validation. Raw posts stay in ignored data/.
limitations: The card reports 48,945 training rows, but the pinned CSV actually contains 49,612. The script records observed counts rather than copying the card.
Source-defined nonclinical labels; no author IDs to verify grouped splits.
Exact deduplication does not eliminate near-duplicate or source-domain bias.
English only; no claim of Indonesian classification performance.
